subject: Kickoff: shared evaluation playbook & timeline (MAP)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cardinaltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: shared evaluation playbook & timeline (MAP)

Hi Daniel — great to meet you on the demo earlier. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan so we have clear owners, success criteria, and an estimated path to a decision. Goal: establish a 6–8 week evaluation that validates latency/cost targets for your inference workloads and confirms integration points with your API layer.

Quick asks for this note:
- Please confirm your primary success criteria (performance, cost per 1k tokens, security controls) and any hard constraints (e.g., on-prem only, no external logging).
- Confirm the internal champion and technical owner we should sync with for the pilot (you mentioned Sara).
- Agree a target decision date — I proposed 2027-01-15 below as a target for an internal purchase decision.

I’ve attached a lightweight MAP template and a draft SOW so you can see a proposed division of responsibilities and timeline. I filled the first-pass timeline based on our call. If that looks good, I’ll convert this into a shared Google Sheet and set up weekly 30-min checkpoints.

Attachments: [MAP_template_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)], [SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Daniel confirms champion and decision date by 12/03
2) We schedule a kickoff workshop with your infra/IT (30–45m) week of 12/06
3) Redwood provides test plan and env checklist by 12/08

Thanks — excited to get moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0142
https://redwood.inference

--
Redwood Inference — Confidential: internal roadmap and pricing details attached are for CardinalTech evaluation only.
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cardinaltech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cardinaltech.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: shared evaluation playbook & timeline (MAP)

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the recap and the template. Quick answers inline: 

- Success criteria: primary is latency (95th percentile under 350ms for our 512-token profiles), secondary is cost per 1k tokens (we’re aiming to be <= $0.015/token-equivalent using our throughput profile). Security: must support our KMS and private VPC peering (no public logs).
- Champion/tech owner: I’ll be the business champion; Sara Patel (copied) is the technical lead and will own the infra-side work. She’ll also coordinate with Procurement for the contract.
- Decision date: We’d like to target an internal decision by 2027-01-12 to align with our Q1 budget cycle.

I took a look at the SOW and have one high-level comment on acceptance testing — we’ll want to add a throughput run using a 30-minute steady-state test at expected concurrency. I’ll put details into the MAP template and send back by EOD 12/03.

Also adding Procurement to the thread (procurement@cardinaltech.com) so they see timelines early.

On the kickoff workshop: week of 12/06 works for us; prefer 12/07 morning PT.

Thanks,
Daniel
Sr. Product Manager — ML Platforms
CardinalTech

Thanks Daniel — perfect. I updated the MAP template with the acceptance test row and a draft schedule that targets 2027-01-12 as your decision date. Highlights of the updated plan (attached):

- Week 1 (12/07): kickoff workshop, environment checklist, test account provisioning
- Week 2–3 (12/13): integration + initial performance runs
- Week 4 (12/20): sustained throughput acceptance test (30m steady-state)
- Week 5–6 (01/03): tuning, runbook handoff, and executive summary for decision

Action items from our side:
- Redwood: provide test harness and sample traffic profile by 12/08 (Tessa)
- CardinalTech: confirm test hosts and KMS keys by 12/10 (Sara)
- Both: 30-min checkpoint calls on 12/14 and 12/21 (tentative)

Attachments: [MAP_template_v1_filled.xlsx (xlsx, 46KB)]

If the schedule and ownership look right I’ll convert this to a shared Google Sheet and set the first checkpoint invite for 12/07 10:00 AM PT.

A couple of notes for Procurement — I’ve included a draft SOW and a description of the test scope so your team can flag any commercial concerns early. Vivek — looping you in for visibility on pricing posture and to track contract milestones.

Thanks — speak soon,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
